title: AWS VPC Traffic Mirroring Configuration
description: Detects creation of VPC Traffic Mirroring sessions/targets/filters, used to duplicate network traffic for capture. Adds VPC Traffic Mirroring (T1020.001) detection beyond the existing SigmaHQ RDS-focused Automated Exfiltration (T1020) rules.
falsePositives: Legitimate network monitoring, IDS, or troubleshooting deployments.
